//: The one generator here that drives a browser: build-og.ts,
which renders the 1200x630 share cards with the site's own
fonts and colours rather than letting them drift from it.
It is separate from tsconfig.json for one reason, and it is
the reason next/, app/ and aab/ each have their own too:
playwright is a devDependency of app/, CI runs `npm ci` at
the root and nowhere else, and a config that cannot resolve
an import fails rather than skipping. So this one carries the
playwright mapping, check-types.ts runs it with `needs: app/`,
and where that install is absent it says so and skips.
A skip is not a pass, which is why the line names what to run.
